marked_text:
Night clerk Luka Vukovic shut the municipal water desk in Podgorica and peeled this from a damp car-
bon set. Vendor [[vendor]]Adriatic Pipeworks d.o.o.[[/]] left bill [[bill_no]]AP-7714[[/]] dated [[issued]]12 March 2026[[/]]. I circled the money total they had already printed, [[total]]18440.50[[/]]. The purchase-order line stayed blank after the courier shrugged at the rain. Old voucher AP-7701 for 902.00 was a prior leak repair and is not this bill. The meter cupboard still clicks, the stamp says PRIMLJENO, and a coffee ring sits on the lower corner.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Firm that issued this water note

marked_text: Workshop lead Senait Berhe in Asmara tore this off a carbon pad once the generator coughed and died. Vendor [[vendor]]Red Sea Diesel Yard[[/]] raised bill [[bill_no]]RSD-3088[[/]] on [[issued]]8 June 2026[[/]] and allowed [[credit]]18[[/]] credit days, leaving the day cash falls due off this copy. Three charge lines are written: [[charge]]injector sleeve[[/]], [[charge]]gasket set[[/]], and [[charge]]shop labour[[/]]. The amount boxed at the right, apart from those words, is [[amount]]3184.75[[/]]. Older slip RSD-3080 showed 410.00 for a different pump. Someone wrote in contanti, then the thumb smeared it.

ask.name: boxed_amount
ask.instruction: Figure printed in the amount box

ask.name: pay_by
ask.instruction: Raised date shifted by the credit days

marked_text: Quarry secretary Anahit Grigoryan at the stone yard in Yerevan typed this after the lunch bell, with dust on the keys. Vendor [[vendor]]Ararat Stone Supply[[/]] issued bill [[bill_no]]ARS-5521[[/]] on [[issued]]14 January 2027[[/]] and noted [[credit]]45[[/]] days of credit in the margin, without dating the end of that stretch. The copied money figure in the total box is [[amount]]9133.40[[/]]. A faded earlier note ARS-5490 mentioned 1507.00 and was crossed in pencil. The account-code line stayed empty. The rubber stamp smeared across the fold, and the yard bell rang twice.

ask.name: bill_number
ask.instruction: Bill number typed on the sheet

ask.name: pay_by
ask.instruction: Margin date shifted by the credit days

ask.name: boxed_amount
ask.instruction: Figure copied from the total box

marked_text: Recepcionista Mateo Quispe in La Paz wrote this with cold fingers before the cable car started. Vendor [[vendor]]Illimani Glassworks[[/]] bill [[bill_no]]IG-2146[[/]] is dated [[issued]]3 August 2026[[/]]. The crew clocked off at [[closed]]4:15 pm[[/]]. Hours [[hours]]6.5[[/]] times the rate [[rate]]48.40[[/]] were left for the office to multiply, and that product is not written on this sheet. Three boxes are ticked: [[item]]pane cut[[/]], [[item]]putty bead[[/]], and [[item]]scaffold time[[/]]. A stale quote of 190.00 from IG-2102 sat in the tray. Sello corrido, and the calle was still icy.

ask.name: labour
ask.instruction: Crew hours multiplied by the rate

marked_text: Cashier Fatima Al-Busaidi at a tyre bay in Muscat jotted this between customers while the wall fan rattled. Vendor [[vendor]]Gulf Rim Tyres[[/]] bill [[bill_no]]GRT-883[[/]] was opened [[opened]]4 November 2026 9:40[[/]]. The paper date under the stamp is [[paper]]19 November 2026[[/]]. Gross [[gross]]6400.00[[/]] minus the credit note [[credit]]875.25[[/]] is for accounts to finish, and the difference is not on this sheet. An old scribble of 210.00 from GRT-790 was ignored. Shukran, the bay is dusty and the stamp slipped sideways onto the margin.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Tyre bay named on the jotting

ask.name: balance
ask.instruction: What remains after the credit note

marked_text: Comptable Amina Dossou in Cotonou copied this from a wet ledger after the afternoon rain. Vendor [[vendor]]Lagune Cold Store[[/]] bill [[bill_no]]LCS-4419[[/]] is dated [[issued]]22 July 2026[[/]]. The three fee lines are [[fee]]132.40[[/]], [[fee]]58.15[[/]] and [[fee]]27.80[[/]], and nobody wrote their addition on the page. The goods named beside them are [[goods]]ice blocks[[/]], [[goods]]crate hire[[/]], and [[goods]]night guard[[/]]. A crossed old total of 64.00 from LCS-4401 is not this bill. Merci, the fan was off and the ink ran into the gutter. I left the blotter on the window ledge to dry.

ask.name: goods
ask.instruction: Each good named beside the fees
